out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink next to dishwashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels at the handwashing sink next to dishwashing machine during inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED THREE HANDWASHING SINKS THAT DO NOT HAVE HANDWASHING SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC HANDWASHING SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED; PIC UNDERSTANDS THE ESTABLISHMENT MAY POST THEIR OWN HANDWASHING SIGNAGE AS WELL.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine. FACILITY DOES NOT HAVE HIGH TEMPERATURE THERMOMETER DISC OR IRREVERSIBLE TEST STRIPS.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT EITHER THE TEST STRIPS OR IRREVERSIBLE THERMO-PLATE SHOULD BE PURCHASED WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y SPLITTER INSTALLED AT MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC WILL INFORM MANAGEMENT TO ENSURE HYDRO SYSTEMS PRESSURE BLEED DUAL VALVE IS PURCHASED WITHIN 3 DAYS.
